additional_info.subject: RE: 0410312 - ID0410312-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / SD 170004222]charging point 1 is unavailable CRM:01251001267
additional_info.body:
Hello Team
1) Check CC2 Plug if there is any water Ingress or Moisture
2) Please check PT1000 resistance value for DC1 in State Monitor KF14
3) Check tightness of cable at F03-XD410 terminals
4) IF PT1000 value is not OK then replace CC2 Cable
5) Please carry spare KF14
6) Last Temperature difference recorded on 27/02/2025 after that no data available for DC1 PT1000.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
